reason: The mechanical claim holds; the proposal built on it does not. (1) CONFIRMED: I re-ran scratchpad/anchor_test.py and got 16/16 OK. The patch set applies with every anchor count == 1, the cells compile, and the changed cells are [4,5] plus 2 new ones on all four notebooks. In cell 5 the line after linefit_smooth_output_graph is the FINAL print in x138, HFV3, amanatar v1 and amanatar v10. (2) The evidence does not reach a real successor. HFV3's diff against x138 over all 12 cells only strips comments and docstrings, so it is an x138 clone scoring 0.953. The amanatar notebooks do change real code, but they carry many division/fork/linefit keyword lines (v1: 62 in cell 5, plus 14 in cell 0, 21 in cell 9 and 29 in cell 10), and amanatar v10 also fails e10_port_gate. The finding's own gate ('0 safe-division/fork/daughter lines') therefore passes only the clone and excludes every notebook that changes real code. Portability to a notebook that both triggers and passes the gate is not shown. A strong successor is also likely to gain on divisions, because the division term dominates (R11-NF). (3) 'The missing code is only a sha-pinned BASES entry' is wrong. The sha is unknown until a trigger, so the builder needs a generic --base-sha256 path. The K2 dummy gate hard-codes x138 constants (dummy_gates.py l.112, raw nodes == 121,777). runtime_ledger maps exp63 to the 7.5 h x138 family (l.71), so SI needs a safetail token. The deadline recipe is unresolved: safetail rewrites the successor's 27000 s guard, while the #35 recipe keeps the degrade cliff. The metadata must be merged, and the DaughterNet weight load sits outside the fail-soft. R11S-4 itself estimates ~120 builder lines plus gates and tests, all needed before R8 (~15.5 h away, and the user is likely asleep until ~06:00Z). (4) VALUE is small and correlated. In the scan's own MC, an early verbatim port gives bronze {port,#37} 0.84/0.89/0.93 against 0.80/0.83/0.87 for {SI,#37} at 0.954/0.955/0.956. SI wins only for silver or when the port is late. Pairing SI with #37 puts the insertion in both finals and drops the insertion-free leg exactly in the private I<0 world (prior 0.10-0.15). With P(trigger) ~10-15%, and ~half of those excluded by the division-line gate, SI's marginal EV over a port-only E10 v2 is ~+0.003-0.01 medal probability. That number comes from an invented model, and there is no lab evidence on any successor. (5) Rules: R8 requires an honest lab gate, and none can exist for an unseen stack ('transfer by construction' is a weaker substitute). The SI read row 'public(SI) >= public(PORT)' chooses between near-copies by 0.001, which R7 forbids outside R3. The insertion's LB record is 'one public embryo twice (x138 family) plus one older stack', not independent 3/3 evidence.
